expectations.text: Returns a Socratic prompt, not an actual cold email
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is a 5-stage prompt; no email drafted.

expectations.text: Has theory + framework + application pointing back at the product
expectations.evidence: Stages: theory, framework, gather, write, critique — points at the user's B2B SaaS product.

expectations.text: Names at least one real copywriting framework
expectations.evidence: Names no established framework — asks the model to 'list the 4-6 underlying forces' and derive them itself; AIDA/PAS/BAB/JTBD never appear.

expectations.text: Leaves a bracketed placeholder rather than inventing details
expectations.evidence: Contains no literal bracketed placeholder; instead instructs the downstream model (step 3) to flag assumptions. It avoids inventing fakes but never leaves a fill-in slot.

expectations.text: Reads as a question-driven prompt, not an instruction with a '?'
expectations.evidence: Mixed: contains real questions but is predominantly an imperative 5-stage mega-prompt ('List…', 'Convert…', 'Now write…').
